title: ARAGNATION
author: Devi Parikh and Abhishek Das
facts: network that maps a position to a color (coordinate MLP, CPPN); layers 5-32-32-32-32-32-32-3, ReLU
data contracts: plain numbers in 7 locked program parts on the Art Blocks core contract
an RGB color for each (x, y) position; some works use palette colors instead
description: Aragnation draws abstract pictures with a watercolor look. A small neural network learned to give a color to each (x, y) position in a picture. Its weights are plain numbers inside the project's program. Ethereum stores the program in seven parts that nobody can change. On the project site, your browser reads the program from Ethereum and runs it. Some works use color palettes instead of the network.

call.note: projectScriptByIndex(401, part) reads one part of the onchain program. Part 3 contains the model weights.
